blocks.label: LC421 maximum XOR query walk
blocks.py:
def max_xor_query(x):               # numbers inserted as bit-paths first
    cur = root; ans = 0
    for b in range(30, -1, -1):
        bit = (x >> b) & 1
        want = 1 - bit               # opposite!
        nxt = cur.ch.get(want)
        if nxt:
            ans |= 1 << b; cur = nxt
        else:
            cur = cur.ch[bit]
    return ans
